environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but with a custom OCI runtime hook that loads a fine-grained seccomp BPF filter via annotation 'seccomp.security.kubernetes.io/pod: localhost/stream-processor-restricted.json'. The profile is derived from the base 'runtime/default' with additional ERRNO returns (EPERM) for syscall numbers 59 (execve), 322 (execveat), 101 (ptrace), 41 (socket), 42 (connect), 49 (bind). The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for these specific syscalls rather than SCMP_ACT_KILL to avoid container crash loops. Note: the archiveAction still functions because write/openat syscalls remain permitted. The profile was generated via 'oci-seccomp-bpf-hook' tracing during normal notify/archive workloads and then manually locked down.
